# TurboTax

> TurboTax is Intuit's comprehensive online tax filing platform offering DIY, expert-assisted, and full-service tax preparation solutions for individuals and small businesses.

TurboTax provides multiple tax filing options ranging from free self-service tools to professional expert assistance, along with tax calculators, educational resources, and year-round tax planning services. The platform supports personal taxes, small business taxes, self-employed filers, and offers features like refund tracking and tax extensions.

- [TurboTax Expert Full Service | Get a Tax Expert to File Your Taxes](https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/online/live/full-service): TurboTax Expert Full Service product page for professional tax filing.
- [TurboTax Desktop | Download Tax Software](https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/cd-download): TurboTax Desktop product page with downloadable tax software options.
- [File Your 2024 Prior Year Taxes with TurboTax Desktop](https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/past-years-products): TurboTax products for filing prior year and past taxes.
